chunks.title: AFD Group / Proparco (France) (Proparco / AFD) COP31 Role & Commitments
chunks.text: AFD Group / Proparco (France) is a Bilateral DFI headquartered in France. At UNFCCC COP31 in Antalya (November 9-20, 2026), its verified role is: Signed €75M sustainable energy financing deal with QNB Leasing at COP31 Antalya (solar & wind power). Verified COP31 2026 climate finance commitment: €75M COP31 QNB Leasing renewable energy deal (>€250M total 2026 renewable leasing mobilization with QNB Leasing). Source verification: https://www.asigazetesi.com/iklim-zirvesi-cop31-antalya-qnb-leasing-ile-proparcodan-75-milyon-avroluk-surdurulebilir-enerji-anlasmasi.

chunks.title: Proparco / AFD Financing Instruments & Ticket Bounds
chunks.text: AFD Group / Proparco (France) provides the following climate financing instruments: Senior Debt, Subordinated Debt, Equity, Green Credit/Leasing Line, Guarantee (Choose Africa / EFSD+), Technical Assistance. Typical transaction ticket range is USD 3,000,000 to USD 120,000,000. Eligible applicant profiles include: Large Corporate, Project SPV, Financial Intermediary, Growth-Stage Private Enterprise, SME.

chunks.title: Proparco / AFD Priority Climate Sectors & Regional Mandate
chunks.text: Priority climate sectors funded by AFD Group / Proparco (France): Renewable Energy, Energy Efficiency, Climate-Smart Agriculture, Sustainable Cities, SME Green Transition, Energy Storage. Target geographic focus includes: Emerging Markets, Developing Countries, Türkiye, Africa, MENA, Asia, Latin America. Projects outside primary regions or ticket bounds may require syndicated or on-lending structures.

chunks.title: Proparco / AFD Mandatory Form & Underwriting Requirements
chunks.text: Mandatory requirements to complete Proparco / AFD's application form: IFC Performance Standards & Proparco E&S Action Plan; 100% Paris-Aligned AFD Group screening; Demonstrated development impact & additionality; Audited financial statements (3 years) or bankable SPV model. Explicit exclusion rules: Coal, upstream oil & gas, heavy fuel oil power. Official application portal: https://www.proparco.fr/en/how-submit-project.

chunks.title: Proparco / AFD Form Template: Development Finance Institution (DFI) / National Dev Bank Project Intake Form
chunks.text: AFD Group / Proparco (France) uses the 'Development Finance Institution (DFI) / National Dev Bank Project Intake Form' workflow governed by IFC Performance Standards / Harmonized DFI Climate Reporting (10by30 / IDFC). Typical review timeline is 4–12 weeks (Screening -> Due Diligence -> Credit Committee). Form sections required: 1. Sponsor Profile, 2. Transaction Structure, 3. Climate & Impact, 4. Financial Due Diligence, 5. Risk Assessment, 6. Executive Summary.
